entries: Separate verified ICM talk identity from earlier lecture and research versions
Narrative from L-values through periods and orbit localization to subconvexity
Define Dirichlet series and absolute convergence
Define finite standard factors with ramified input identified
Define analytic conductor and its t growth
Separate convexity theorem, subconvex definition and Lindelof conjecture
Preserve strict delta endpoint and fixed-pi quantifiers
Preserve common scale bounds and finite conductor exponent
Prove t-aspect deduction, including bounded t and exact delta quantifiers
Define smooth group and tangent algebra; expose exponential prerequisites
Specify inverse and sign in dual action
Define coadjoint orbit and prove its coset parametrization
Prove trace identification and principal-block restriction
Define strong continuity and closed invariant-subspace convention
Define smooth vectors and domain of differentiated action
Construct weak integrated operator and prove L1 norm bound
Define Schwartz class and its uniformly bounded seminorm families independently of unrelated categorical Schwartz spaces
Fix Fourier signs and prove translation and modulation identities
Compute Gaussian Fourier transform by a first-order equation and normalize its integral
Distinguish ordinary from semiclassical frequency width
Define absolutely convergent quantization for Schwartz symbols
Give local group quantization with negative Fourier phase, Jacobian and compact cutoff explicit
Prove one-dimensional intertwiner comparison, retain normalization
Prove finite-group averaging is orthogonal projection
Define period with convergence and quotient-measure assumptions
Define disjoint spectra of matrix and principal block
Prove 2x2 transverse commutator lemma entry by entry
Prove Euler product by finite products and absolute-convergence tails
Decode Gamma factors and parameter convention
Define cuspidality, center quotient and unitary realization
Make constant dependencies and uniformity explicit
Define conductor by K1 fixed vectors, cite newvector theorem
Prove integer prime factorization from Bezout
State local zeta construction and mark its theorem inputs
Define Gamma and derive continuation recurrence
Prove product formula for rational ideles
Prove inverse function theorem via explicit contracting iteration
Define nonarchimedean genericity and Whittaker functions, cite multiplicity one
Prove Fubini-Tonelli by rectangles, lambda systems and monotone approximation
Prove Schwartz Fourier inversion by Gaussian regularization
Prove Schur kernel estimate on all L2 classes
Prove h-uniform operator norm using kernel integration by parts
Prove all finite orders with uniform Schwartz remainder and L2 error
Deduce commutator leading term with explicit sign and O(h2) operator error
Prove nonstationary phase by iterated integration by parts
Prove fixed-Schwartz cutoff errors uniformly in unitary representation
Prove exact symbol multiplication for additive group representations
Define cyclic vector and prove determination of commuting maps
Prove spectral separation forces cyclic row and column without semisimplicity
Prove group and infinitesimal stabilizers trivial in arbitrary rank
Prove quantitative local lower Lipschitz and preimage volume bound
Prove local single-orbit Haar small-ball bound uniformly on stable compact sets
Prove second-order BCH by convergent matrix power series
Prove first Lie-star correction with compact-frequency O(h2) error only
Define exact star convolution and prove operator composition
Prove dominated convergence via Fatou from monotone convergence
Prove multivariable integral Taylor remainder from one-variable FTC
Prove smooth compact-support density by rectangle approximation and explicit cutoffs
Prove Gaussian normalization using only one-variable substitutions and Tonelli
Prove rectangle approximation by finite-measure sigma-algebra argument
